content: Observed CO2 flux anomalies are largely driven by wetland extent misclassification in tropical basins rather than actual interannual emissions changes.
falsification_criteria: If correcting wetland masks using SAR inundation products does not reduce flux residuals by ≥25% in 3 basins, the hypothesis is false.

plan.description: Re-run inversion with updated wetland prior from Sentinel-1 and compare residual structure.

content: Aerosol optical depth (AOD) retrieval biases during biomass burning seasons are inflating inferred respiration in top-down CO2 inversions.
falsification_criteria: If substituting AOD from AERONET-constrained reanalysis leaves respiration sensitivity unchanged (Δ<5%) across 2 seasons, reject.

plan.description: Swap aerosol fields (MERRA-2 vs CAMS vs AERONET-adjusted) and quantify inversion posterior differences.

content: A missing soil moisture constraint in the prior causes systematic overestimation of drought impacts on net ecosystem exchange.
falsification_criteria: If adding SMAP soil moisture as a prior constraint does not reduce drought-period NEE bias vs FLUXNET by ≥0.2 gC m−2 d−1, falsify.

plan.description: Incorporate SMAP L3 soil moisture into prior parameterization and evaluate against FLUXNET tower sites.

content: Regional transport model boundary layer height errors are the dominant source of mismatch during wintertime CO2 peaks in mid-latitudes.
falsification_criteria: If swapping PBLH from ERA5 to MERRA-2 does not shift peak timing error by ≥2 hours in 5 target stations, falsify.

plan.description: Run transport sensitivity with alternate PBLH products and compare to in-situ station diurnal cycles.

content: The apparent long-term sink increase is a data-assimilation artifact caused by changing station network density after 2015.
falsification_criteria: If holding the observing network fixed (2010 mask) still yields ≥80% of the sink trend, the hypothesis is false.

plan.description: Perform network-denial experiments with fixed station masks and compare posterior sink trends.

content: Selection bias in published fMRI studies (small-N, flexible ROIs) explains a substantial fraction of reported amygdala hyperactivity effects.
falsification_criteria: If effect sizes from preregistered large-N cohorts remain within 10% of meta-analytic estimates after correction, reject this bias-driven claim.

plan.description: Recompute meta-effects separating preregistered vs non-preregistered studies; apply robust variance estimation.

content: Head-motion residuals in clinical cohorts are inflating group differences attributed to anxiety severity in resting-state connectivity analyses.
falsification_criteria: If adding motion-scrubbing + ICA-AROMA reduces group effect sizes by <0.05 in Fisher-z units across 10 edges, falsify.

plan.description: Reprocess a benchmark dataset with motion-robust pipelines and compare connectivity group contrasts.

content: Reported hippocampal volume reductions are partially driven by segmentation tool version drift between studies rather than biology.
falsification_criteria: If harmonizing segmentations (FreeSurfer v7.4) changes cross-study mean differences by <2%, reject the tool-drift explanation.

plan.description: Re-segment shared T1w datasets with pinned versions and quantify volumetric shifts vs published values.

content: LLM-generated lab protocols reduce novice error rates mainly by improving reagent ordering and timing cues rather than conceptual understanding.
falsification_criteria: If novices using protocols with removed timing/order cues perform no worse than full protocols (Δerror <5%), this mechanism is false.

plan.description: A/B test protocol variants in a wet-lab simulation; measure error categories and completion time.

content: Perceived trust in AI protocol assistance is primarily driven by citations to canonical sources (NEB, Addgene) rather than model transparency text.
falsification_criteria: If removing citations does not reduce trust ratings by ≥0.4 on a 7-point scale across two cohorts, falsify.

plan.description: Run a randomized survey with protocol cards varying citations vs explanation depth; fit mixed-effects model.

content: Knowledge gaps reported by novices cluster around implicit assumptions (sterility, buffer pH) that experts omit from written protocols.
falsification_criteria: If expert-written protocols with added 'assumption checklists' do not reduce clarification questions by ≥30%, falsify.

plan.description: Code novice questions from sessions; compare against protocol text to identify omitted assumptions and test checklist intervention.

content: A substantial share of reported EV battery degradation at high C-rate is due to thermal sensor placement error rather than true cell aging.
falsification_criteria: If relocating sensors (tab vs can wall) changes inferred peak temperature by <2°C and degradation curves remain unchanged, falsify.

plan.description: Repeat high C-rate cycling with multiple thermocouple placements and compare degradation diagnostics (dQ/dV, impedance).

content: Fast-charging lithium plating in graphite anodes can be mitigated mainly by brief pulsed rest steps rather than overall current reduction.
falsification_criteria: If adding 5s rest per 60s charge does not reduce plating markers (Coulombic inefficiency, Li metal signal) by ≥15%, falsify.

plan.description: Compare constant-current vs pulsed-rest charge profiles; quantify plating via CE, dV/dQ, and post-mortem SEM.

content: In protein structure prediction benchmarks, leakage from training via near-duplicate sequences accounts for much of the reported gain since 2021.
falsification_criteria: If enforcing ≤30% identity train/test split reduces top-1 accuracy by <3 points on CASP-like targets, the leakage explanation is false.

plan.description: Rebuild benchmark with strict sequence identity filters; re-evaluate two open models on the cleaned split.

content: Reported improvements in docking scores are primarily due to relaxed protonation/tautomer handling rather than better pose prediction.
falsification_criteria: If standardizing protonation/tautomer enumeration yields the same ranking gains (ΔAUC <0.01 change), falsify this attribution.

plan.description: Fix protonation pipeline (Epik-like rules) and re-run docking comparisons on the same target set.

content: Clinical trial outcome discrepancies between registry and publication are driven mainly by post hoc endpoint switching in phase II oncology studies.
falsification_criteria: If endpoint concordance remains ≥90% after comparing time-stamped registry snapshots to published primary endpoints, falsify switching claim.

plan.description: Sample phase II oncology trials; compare ClinicalTrials.gov history to publications; quantify endpoint changes and timing.

content: Industry-sponsored trials show fewer reported adverse events because of differential coding using MedDRA aggregation choices, not true safety differences.
falsification_criteria: If harmonizing AE coding at PT-level eliminates sponsor effect (OR moves within 1.05–0.95), falsify coding explanation.

plan.description: Recode adverse events to consistent PT-level categories and re-estimate sponsor association with AE rates.

content: A large fraction of single-cell RNA-seq doublets are missed because ambient RNA correction is applied before doublet detection in common pipelines.
falsification_criteria: If swapping the order (doublet detection before ambient correction) does not increase validated doublet calls by ≥10% in 3 datasets, falsify.

plan.description: Run Scrublet/DoubletFinder before and after ambient RNA correction (SoupX/CellBender) and validate with genotype-based labels.
